items.q: Is it worth replacing a Land Rover engine?
items.a: It depends on vehicle value versus replacement cost. High-value models like a Range Rover Sport or Defender L663 often justify replacement, while lower-value models may not. Use the diagnostic calculator for a personalised verdict.

items.q: Which Land Rover engine should I avoid?
items.a: The 3.0 TDV6/SDV6 (306DT) and 2.7 TDV6 (276DT) carry the most expensive failure risks – crankshaft bearing and oil pump housing failures respectively. Pre-2019 204DTD Ingenium diesels also need timing chain checks.
Post-2019 Ingenium engines are significantly improved. Earlier 204DTD diesels are known for timing chain tensioner wear, so service history and a cold-start listen matter on pre-2019 cars.

items.q: Discovery 4 vs Discovery 5 – which is more reliable?
items.a: The Discovery 5 with the revised post-2019 Ingenium has the stronger ownership profile. A Discovery 4 SDV6 can still be a good buy with full service history and proven oil-interval discipline.

items.q: How do I know if my Land Rover is worth repairing?
items.a: Use the 60% rule: if a reconditioned engine costs 60% or more of what your car is worth today, get a scrap valuation alongside any repair quote before deciding.

items.q: Which is the safest Range Rover to buy used?
items.a: The L405 (2012–2021). Typical values of £14,000–£55,000 against £6,500–£12,000 recon cost keep replacement comfortably viable across almost every example.

items.q: Where does your data come from?
items.a: From 9,000+ real UK engine enquiries handled through EnginesMarket, combined with replacement quotes from vetted JLR specialists. Third-party value bands are labelled as such.

items.q: How are your replacement cost ranges calculated?
items.a: Ranges come from real reconditioned, supply-only quotes from specialists, refreshed monthly – not from averages or guesswork. Fitting costs vary by garage and are quoted separately.

items.q: Do you sell engines or parts?
items.a: No. This guide is independent advice. If you want a quote, we can connect you with vetted JLR specialists in the Engine Finders network – there is no obligation.

items.q: Are your guides model and engine specific?
items.a: Yes. Every guide is written for a specific Land Rover or Range Rover model, generation or engine code, using exact JLR terminology and OEM part references.

items.q: How often is the information updated?
items.a: Monthly. Enquiry volumes, failure trends and cost ranges are reviewed every month so you always see the latest picture.
